result.title: Discrete Wasserstein Flows for One-Step Generative Modeling
result.summary: We introduce a new framework for one-step generative modelling on finite state spaces. To extend drifting beyond continuous domains, we use discrete Wasserstein geometry to define a target-relative KL gradient flow over the transitions of a reversible Markov kernel. We realize this probability flow at the particle level through Markov jumps and amortize the resulting transport updates into a latent-conditioned generator, so that the iterative dynamics are required only during training while inference remains one-step. In a controlled setting where the underlying distributions and transport dynamics can be computed exactly, we verify KL dissipation, consistency between the particle dynamics and the probability flow, and the predicted numerical scaling. We further show that a finite-capacity neural generator can track these exact transport targets while retaining one-step generation. These results validate the basic construction and provide a foundation for scaling Discrete Drifting to structured discrete data.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出离散状态空间上的一步生成建模框架：用离散 Wasserstein 几何在可逆马尔可夫核的转移上定义目标相关的 KL 梯度流，将粒子级 Markov 跳跃的迭代输运摊销为隐变量条件生成器，训练时用迭代动力学、推理时一步生成，并在可精确计算的受控设定下验证 KL 耗散、粒子动力学与概率流的一致性及数值缩放。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但「训练期迭代输运 + 隐状态条件生成 + 推理一步化」的摊销思路，可能可供核查 latent 推理中轨迹训练与贡献分配、动态计算成本控制等问题。
